newsitem.title: FRANCE: Italy export agency resumes guarantees to Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Italy export agency resumes guarantees to Algeria.

text.p: The Italian government export credit agency SACE is to resume providing insurance export guarantees to Italian companies exporting to Algeria, the Algerian official news agency APS said on Tuesday.
"I announce to you the good news, the SACE is opening for Algeria where positive political and economic signals deserve such a re-opening," said SACE director-general Mario Mauro, quoted by APS.
The agency said he was addressing Arab and Italian businessmen in Naples.
Mauro said his agency would provide an initial total of $200 million as export guarantees for Italian firms sending goods to Algeria.

"Of the total, SACE commitment will guarantee 70 percent of the value of exports from big Italian companies to the Algerian market. The (guarantee) rate will be increased to 90 percent for small and medium-sized companies," he said according to APS.
Italian exports totalled more than $900 million in 1995 while Algeria exported products, mainly gas and oil, worth more than $2.0 billion, according to official Algerian figures.
